acquirer.name: Invesco Van Kampen Senior Loan Fund

listed_quote.quote: The proposed reorganization is part of a larger group of reorganizations across Invesco’s mutual fund platform.

announcement.quote: The Invesco Funds Board of Trustees has approved a reorganization of Invesco Prime Income Trust into Invesco Van Kampen Senior Loan Fund, pending shareholder approval.

outcome_evidence.quote: The proposed reorganization is part of a larger group of reorganizations across Invesco’s mutual fund platform.

deals.notes: Listing status is inferred from the filing describing the reorganization as part of Invesco's mutual fund platform (symbols shown under a 'Nasdaq Symbol' heading are not exchange tickers of listed shares). Independently of that, the merger's own outcome is not stated: the shareholder meeting of April 14, 2011 was adjourned repeatedly (May 11, June 30, Sept 14, Sept 22, Oct 19, 2011) and the last filing in the window (2011-09-23) still shows the vote pending.

problems: Whether the funds are exchange-listed is not stated outright; false is inferred from the 'mutual fund platform' wording. If that inference is rejected, both_listed should be null and the outcome null (merger outcome is not stated in any excerpt).
